Student Home (chosen direction B, sample data)
1. My Day: Streak → Solved Without Help; Focus → Mistakes Fixed
2. Your Progress: Term 1 topics secure (18/26), IIT and India Explorer hours against weekly targets
3. Subject Mastery: levels (Introduced → Developing → Competent → Mastered) with a Review due marker, not %
4. Student menu: Parent section removed (separate parent login); added 'What my parent sees'
5. AI Companion: study-support wording

Parent Dashboard · Overview (sample data)
Answers the parent questions from PRINCIPLES: Is learning improving? Becoming more independent? Studying consistently? Workload balanced? Strengths and gaps? How can I help?
• Separate parent login; student switcher ready for more children later
• Patterns, not surveillance: session history lives under Safety & Privacy, not on the overview
• IIT test readiness shows 'Not tracked yet' until IIT integration (Phase 3)
• Chart colours checked for colour-blind safety; charts carry labels and legends

Reference replica (direction A, not chosen)
Every section, label and menu copied from the reference image. Only the name changed to Scholr.
